lines.text: A list of recommendations is lovely. But sometimes you already have a hero in mind and would like a second opinion before making it everybody else's problem.
Meet the hero inspector. Open it using this button, or press F4. A second opinion without having to speak to another Dota player. Revolutionary.
lines.hint: Open the hero inspector using its button or F4.

lines.text: Yes, it floats. No, you do not have to leave it there. Unlike certain teammates, this window will actually go where you tell it.
Grab its header and move it somewhere comfortable. Leave the hero grid and draft slots reachable. Parking it on top of the work does rather defeat the purpose.
lines.hint: Drag the inspector header, move it a little, then release.

lines.text: Excellent. Window management. Put that on the CV. You can keep moving it whenever it gets in your way.
Let's audition Sand King. Search for him and left-click his portrait. An audition, mind you. We haven't offered him the job.
lines.hint: Search for Sand King and left-click him.

lines.text: There he is. Inside the inspector, not inside the draft. While this window is open, left-clicking an available hero changes the inspected candidate.
The list scrolls inside this window. If a row is hiding, scroll the inspector. I put the numbers in here so they wouldn't colonise the hero grid.
His total is -3.07. Omniknight alone contributes -3.27. Apparently divine intervention has its limits. These are raw teammate and opponent contributions: no purple composition bonuses.
The inspector follows Picking for. Switch that to Dire, using the button or F2. We can interview the same scorpion for the other side without moving a single drafted hero.
lines.hint: Switch Picking for to Dire using the button or F2.

lines.text: Now Weaver is a potential teammate and Radiant supplies the opponents. Same candidate, different interview. The recommendation feed has its own side switch; these are two different questions.
Back to Radiant, please. We are investigating a questionable decision, not defecting halfway through the tutorial.
lines.hint: Switch Picking for back to Radiant.

lines.text: Dire has decided to pick Lina. Search for her, then drag her into Dire's draft slots. Keep Sand King under inspection. Left-clicking would stop inspection on Sand King.
lines.hint: Drag Lina into Dire. Keep Sand King inspected.

lines.text: Lina joined Dire. Sand King stayed in the inspector. His new Lina row contributes -1.67 and his total is now -4.74. The draft changes, the inspection updates. Our candidate's interview is going spectacularly badly.
Right-clicking still bans heroes while the inspector is open. Find Lion and right-click him. He has volunteered to sit this one out. He just doesn't know it yet.
lines.hint: Search for Lion and right-click to ban him.

lines.text: Lion is banned. Sand King remains our candidate. Left-click inspects, dragging picks, right-click bans. We have a system. Please resist the urge to improvise.
Perhaps we should interview someone else. Find Earthshaker and left-click him. Replacing an inspected hero costs us nothing. Replacing an actual last-pick disaster tends to require another queue.
lines.hint: Search for Earthshaker and left-click to inspect him.

lines.text: +3.33. A stronger matchup total for this draft, with no commitment required to compare them. Whether you can land an Echo Slam remains outside my department.
Let's give Earthshaker the job. Click Pick Earthshaker for Radiant inside the inspector. Check the team written on that button. Reading it is considerably cheaper than apologising afterwards.
lines.hint: Use the inspector button to pick Earthshaker for Radiant.

lines.text: Now he's in the draft. The inspector stays open, and its pick button prevents a duplicate. One Earthshaker is plenty. We have enough coordination problems already.
Close the inspector with its X or F4. With it closed, ordinary left-clicks pick heroes again. The interview room is shut; recruitment can resume.
lines.hint: Close the inspector using its X or F4.

lines.text: There. You can examine a candidate, keep watching as the draft changes, compare an alternative and commit when you're ready. Almost suspiciously responsible behaviour for a Dota player.

interruptions.text: That's a click. Drag Lina to Dire; Sand King is still mid-interview.
Left button auditions. Right button bans. Lion isn't auditioning.
Use the inspector's pick button this time. We already know you can drag.
We're halfway through an interview. You can't just close the office.
